route.title: Your route
route.inviteBody: The course is long. Tell me what you're after and I'll mark the way. You can add or remove anything afterwards.

blurbs.LONG: Sort out your money, choose well what to invest in and build a portfolio you can hold for years.
blurbs.TRADING: How the market works, how to read a chart and how to trade without wiping yourself out.
blurbs.ALL: Every section, in the usual order.

lumiPick.LONG: From what you told me at the start, I'd put you on «Long-term investor». It's only my advice: pick whichever you like.
lumiPick.TRADING: From what you told me at the start, I'd put you on «I want to understand trading». It's only my advice: pick whichever you like.
lumiPick.NONE: Pick the route closest to what you're after. It doesn't close anything off: you can add or remove units afterwards.

route.step2Hint: Remove what doesn't interest you and add what does. I'll tell you if something is needed first.
route.outHint: All of this stays open and you can go in whenever you like. If you add it, it becomes part of your route.

route.notePreset: This is the route as I'd do it. Now make it yours.

why.s0: The way into the course: what investing is and your first virtual purchase.
why.s1: Before investing: emergency fund, budget and debts. I wouldn't skip it.
why.s2: How buying and selling really works. It opens almost everything else.
why.s3: Shares, bonds and funds: what you'll end up holding.
why.s4: If crypto tempts you, better to understand it before putting money in.
why.s5: Currencies and commodities: useful curiosity, not essential.
why.s6: For those who want to pick companies one by one and understand their accounts.
why.s7: Charts, candlesticks and indicators. If you like looking at charts, this is your section.
why.s8: How much to risk and how to trade with a plan. Essential if you're going to trade.
why.s9: The costliest mistakes are in your head. Useful for everyone.
why.s10: How to spread your money and keep it steady.
why.s11: Taxes, scams and how to choose a broker before putting real money in.
why.s12: What past bubbles and crises teach.
why.s13: Challenges with real data to test what you've learned.
